tools.name: logzio_whoami
tools.description: Return the name and id of the Logz.io account this token belongs to. Logz.io API: GET /v2/whoami.

tools.name: logzio_list_log_types
tools.description: List the log types (log type names) that the account has received. Use them to narrow a log search. Logz.io API: GET /v1/account/log-types.

tools.name: logzio_list_time_based_accounts
tools.description: List the time-based log accounts (main and sub accounts) with retention and name settings. Logz.io API: GET /v1/account-management/time-based-accounts.

tools.name: logzio_list_archive_settings
tools.description: List the archiving settings of the account (where logs are archived and how). Logz.io API: GET /v2/archive/settings.

tools.name: logzio_search_logs
tools.description: Search log messages with a Lucene query inside a time range. Returns the matching hits. Use `*` as the query for all logs. Returns up to 100 hits per call; page with `from`. Logz.io API: POST /v1/search.

tools.name: logzio_list_alerts
tools.description: List the alert rules of the account with their enabled state, tags and search time frame. Logz.io API: GET /v2/alerts.

tools.name: logzio_get_alert
tools.description: Return one alert rule by id, with its query, conditions and notification settings. Logz.io API: GET /v2/alerts/{alertId}.

tools.name: logzio_list_triggered_alerts
tools.description: List alerts that fired, with their name, severity and event date. Filter by severity, name text or tags. Logz.io API: POST /v1/alerts/triggered-alerts.

tools.name: logzio_set_alert_enabled
tools.description: Enable or disable one alert rule. A disabled alert sends no notifications until it is enabled again. Repeating the same call leaves the alert in the same state. Logz.io API: POST /v2/alerts/{id}/enable or /disable.

tools.name: logzio_list_insights
tools.description: List the log insights that Logz.io found for the account (new error patterns and similar). Logz.io API: POST /v1/insights/list.

tools.name: logzio_list_audit_events
tools.description: List account audit trail events (who changed what, and when), newest first by default. Logz.io API: POST /v1/audit-trail.

tools.name: logzio_list_dashboard_folders
tools.description: List the dashboard folders (projects) of the account. Logz.io API: GET /perses-public/api/v1/projects.

tools.name: logzio_list_dashboards
tools.description: List the dashboards of the account with their folder id and name. Logz.io API: GET /perses-public/api/v1/dashboards.

tools.name: logzio_get_dashboard
tools.description: Return one dashboard with its panels and queries. Needs the folder id and dashboard uid from logzio_list_dashboards. Logz.io API: GET /perses-public/api/v1/projects/{projectId}/dashboards/{dashboardId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: logzio_search_logs, logzio_get_alert, logzio_list_triggered_alerts, logzio_list_insights, logzio_list_audit_events · Private data: logzio_whoami · Public sink: logzio_search_logs, logzio_list_triggered_alerts, logzio_set_alert_enabled, logzio_list_insights, logzio_list_audit_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: logzio_search_logs, logzio_get_alert, logzio_list_triggered_alerts, logzio_list_insights, logzio_list_audit_events · Private data: logzio_whoami · Public sink: logzio_search_logs, logzio_list_triggered_alerts, logzio_set_alert_enabled, logzio_list_insights, logzio_list_audit_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
